import math

def min_Jumps(jump, d):
    """
    jump: tuple (x, y) representing one jump vector
    d: distance along x-axis of the target point (d, 0)
    
    Number of jumps = d / length of the jump vector
    """
    x, y = jump
    length = math.hypot(x, y)
    if length == 0:
        return float('inf')
    return d / length
